rationale: 候选第二命题截断于『outdated documents that have data leakage problems』，其后关键命题全部缺失：『an emphasis on short dependency tasks rather than long dependency tasks』（第三项缺陷）、『over 24,000 tokens per document and 6,000 newly generated questions』（数值）、『more than 1,100 high-quality question-answer pairs』、四项发现『(i) commercial models outperformed open-sourced models』等，均为关键命题遗漏，E3。
